connector_visibility.description: Main-flow, supporting, and return paths are readable and unambiguous. Arrowheads meet the intended components; shared routes must not obscure opposing directions or suggest a false dependency.

primary_agent_hierarchy.description: When an agent is evidenced, the primary agent has clear visual emphasis. When no agent is required, no agent or conversational channel has been invented.

empty_space.description: Canvas dimensions reflect the whole topology and measured content. No empty product/layer slots or full-width single control cards; intentional route clearance and whitespace remain balanced.

overall_composition.description: The architecture is an open, requirements-driven composition with an evidenced main path, nearby supporting branches, and compact controls where applicable. Stage and row counts suit the actual graph, not a mandatory set of layer containers or a four-stage template. The sequence remains professionally aligned and readable.

html_preview.description: The local HTML preview displays both matching PNGs, offers working SVG and PNG links, and supports fit-width and actual-size viewing without external assets or a web server.
